messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert: p99 latency > 3s on /v1/generate for 'int8-fast-calib-v2' cluster in us-west-2. Trigger: sustained 10m breach. Incident priority: P1
Sanjay (oncall): I'm on it. Rerouting traffic to legacy int8-safe-1 and fp16 pools, will post actions.
Alex (eng-runtime): Confirmed spike correlates with last night's quantization rollout: profile= int8-fast-calib-v2, deployed 02:13 UTC. Seeing heavy tail at p99 and intermittent streaming stalls.
Marta (eng-ml): Calibration logs show some outlier layers with high dynamic range; fallback tables might be misapplied for a small subset of tokens. Possible precision -> kernel path mismatch.
Liz (prodops): Rolling traffic off the new profile now. Running: `/routing set-weight int8-fast-calib-v2 0.0 --grace 30s` and `/routing set-weight int8-safe-1 0.6 fp16-default 0.4`
Sanjay (oncall): Routing change acknowledged. Early metrics: p95 down from 420ms -> 310ms, p99 still ~2.9s but trending down.
Alex (eng-runtime): Observed streaming stalls in runtime logs: repeated "KV_CACHE_CHUNK_MISS, retrying kernel" for sessions hitting sequence lengths > 1024. Suspect calibration produced quant tables that force a slower fallback kernel for those lengths.
Marta (eng-ml): Repro script attached:```python
# repro minimal
req = make_request(model='int8-fast-calib-v2', seq=1400, prompt='repeat("x ", 1200)')
print(call(req).timings())
```
Chen (customer-success): Any idea which customers hit the highest latency? Priya is pinging.
Priya (acct-exec): We have three enterprise customers with heavy streaming workloads: AcmeCorp, FinApps, and MedData. Need ETA to communicate.
Sanjay (oncall): Initial logs show ~65% of errors/timeouts from AcmeCorp traffic. I'll mark them as impacted. Setting incident label: customer-impact = partial (3 customers).
ops-bot: Added incident-runbook tag: quant-rollout. On-call handoff scheduled in 30m if not resolved.
Alex (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations: 1) rollback int8-fast-calib-v2 to previous int8-safe-1 (in progress), 2) enable fp16 fallback for streaming routes to avoid quant kernel path for long sequences, 3) increase per-request timeout on streaming to 45s to avoid premature client errors while we stabilize.
Liz (prodops): Rollback command executed: `/deploy rollback int8-fast-calib-v2 --to int8-safe-1 --force` — deployment status: in-flight, 3/3 regions done except eu-west-1.
Marta (eng-ml): We should also quarantine telemetry from the rollout for offline debug (retain raw activations for 24h). I'll create a snapshot export.
Sanjay (oncall): Update: p99 now 1.2s in us-west-2 after reroute & rollback step for that region. eu-west-1 still at 2.7s.
Chen (customer-success): Messaging draft for customers: "We detected degraded tail latency for a quantization profile deployed yesterday affecting streaming responses to certain long-sequence workloads. We have rerouted traffic and rolled back the profile; performance is recovering. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigations." Any objections?
Priya (acct-exec): Good to send ASAP to the three impacted customers, include ETA: 2 hours for full recovery, and offer a callback.
Alex (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: calibration process produced quantization tables that caused sporadic kernel selection to route to a non-optimized attention kernel on sequences >1024, causing stalls and KV-cache retries. Also saw increased memory pressure triggering GC-like stalls for some gpu runtimes.
Marta (eng-ml): Action items for ML team: 1) revert calibration params that allowed aggressive clipping, 2) run synthetic long-seq load against recalibrated profile, 3) add acceptance test for kernel-path stability across seq length distribution.
Liz (prodops): Playbook additions: require A/B canary for quant profiles with at least 48h synthetic long-seq verification and a p99 SLA gate before global rollout.
Sanjay (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (in 28m): rollback completed for primary regions, ongoing validation in eu-west-1, watch p99 and streaming stall metric `runtime/streaming/stalls` and `runtime/kernel_fallbacks`. If p99 > 1.5s for 10m, re-open page.
Alex (eng-runtime): Debug dump examples (short):
```
[2025-11-24T02:35:10Z] session=abcd kernel=fallback_attention_v2 seq=1400 time=2890ms KV_CACHE_CHUNK_MISS
[2025-11-24T02:35:12Z] session=abcd retry kernel=fallback_attention_v2 time=3120ms
```
Sanjay (oncall): Current impact summary: p95 within SLO; p99 breached for ~35 minutes, affecting streaming stalls and causing increased error rates for 3 enterprise customers. No data exfiltration, no model quality regression reported.
Chen (customer-success): I'm scheduling customer calls and will post notes in #customer-notifs.
Marta (eng-ml): Will prepare a postmortem draft focusing on calibration validation gap and runtime kernel-selection checks.
Liz (prodops): Closing loop: documented mitigation steps and updated runbook. Marking this incident as "mitigated" for now, will transition to postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: MITIGATED -> Postmortem required. Owner: Marta (eng-ml).
Sanjay (oncall): Final note in-thread: if anyone sees residual spikes, ping me directly. Handing off to Marta for RCA work. Thanks team. :heart:
